coverage_note: Reviewed all supplied PDF text and figure captions. Supplementary materials and figure pixels were not supplied.

findings.candidate_quote: the pipeline correctly identified expansions in 82% of DM1 subjects
findings.reference_quote:
All patients
with DM1 were confirmed by ONT sequencing having > 50
repeats.
findings.explanation: The 82% refers to agreement with Southern blot classification, not expansion detection: native ONT agreed in 28/34 cases, and long-PCR classification agreed in 41/50. All DM1 patients were detected as expanded. Despite the preceding statement that all cases were characterized, this sentence incorrectly presents classification concordance as the detection rate.
